ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a triangle, with a small square marking the right angle at the lower-left corner; the left side of the triangle is approximately vertical, the base is horizontal, and the hypotenuse slopes from the upper left toward the lower right. Except for the right angle, arc marks are drawn at the other two vertices, and both of these arcs are outside the triangle, located outside the upper-left vertex and outside the lower-right vertex respectively. Reasoning: Let the two interior angles of the triangle other than the right angle be A and B. Because the sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, and one of the angles is 90°, A + B = 90°. The two marked angles asked about in the figure are the exterior angles of these two interior angles; each exterior angle and the corresponding interior angle form a linear pair, so they are respectively 180° - A and 180° - B. Their sum is (180° - A) + (180° - B) = 360° - (A + B) = 360° - 90° = 270°.

method.method_draft: Read the image as a right triangle with the right angle marked at the lower-left vertex, and with the other two marked arcs drawn outside the triangle at the upper-left and lower-right vertices. Let the two non-right interior angles of the triangle be A and B. From the text, the triangle contains a right angle, so A + B = 90°. Each marked exterior angle in the image forms a linear pair with its corresponding interior angle, so the marked angles are 180° - A and 180° - B. Their sum is (180° - A) + (180° - B) = 360° - (A + B) = 360° - 90° = 270°.

method.method_draft: Read the image as a horizontal base, a vertical left side, and a slanted side; the square shows the horizontal and vertical sides are perpendicular. Let x be the acute angle that the slanted side makes with the horizontal base at the right vertex inside the triangle. Then the marked exterior angle at the right vertex is the supplement of x, so it is 180° - x. Because the vertical side is perpendicular to the horizontal base, the acute interior angle at the upper-left vertex is 90° - x. The marked exterior angle there is its supplement, 180° - (90° - x) = 90° + x. Adding the two marked angles gives (180° - x) + (90° + x) = 270°.
